description: Live prices and plan limits from `GET /v1/plans`. Use before estimating cost or when asked about free credits, rate limits or per-method prices. Units: 1 billing unit = `pricing.cu_per_unit` CU; 1 USD buys `pricing.units_per_usd` units. `method_weights` includes JSON-RPC and Data API CU per call, `push.log` / `push.native_transfer` / `push.token_transfer` per delivered data event, `push.history` per successful history request and `push.address_day` per billable address-day; resolve a method by exact match, then the longest prefix rule ending in `*`, then the `*` row (JSON-RPC only; Data API and push operations have no default). `free.*` values are in billing units; `key_defaults` are the free-account new-key default CU/s and burst CU; `paid_key_minimums` (when present, otherwise null or absent) are the paid-account per-key lower bounds in CU/s and burst CU — a floor, not a cap, and not any key's actual value (the first paid top-up raises each key to at least this floor and higher custom limits are kept; actual limits are per key in the console). `promo.ends_at` is a sign-up coverage cutoff, not the end of the offer. For a single method's chain support and documentation use get_method_info instead; for projecting cycle costs use estimate_usage instead.
name: get_pricing
title: Get Plans and Pricing
